description: Use this when the user wants customer statements (customer statement template, statement of account, open item statement) for customers who owe them money, from the same open invoices: typed, pasted CSV/TSV, or an attached CSV/XLSX export. Returns a PDF with one page per customer listing each open invoice with date, due date, amount, paid, open balance and days past due, an aging strip and the balance due, plus polite past-due reminder email drafts. Filter by customer names or overdue_only. Does not send statements or emails, and does not build an aging summary (use generate_aging_report).

as_of_date.description: Age the invoices as of this date, e.g. "2026-10-31". Default today in New York time.

company_address.description: Your address or contact lines for the statement header, e.g. "12 Main St, Austin TX 78701, billing@brightpath.com".

company_name.description: Your business name for the report header and email sign-off, e.g. "Bright Path Design LLC".

currency.description: Currency code, e.g. "USD" (default), "CAD", "EUR". With a mixed-currency file, only this currency is aged.

customers.description: Only these customers, e.g. ["Acme Corp", "Globex"] or "Acme Corp, Globex". Default every customer with a balance.

default_terms.description: Terms for invoices with no due date and no terms, e.g. "Net 30" (default) or 15.

file.description: An open invoices or A/R aging export (CSV, TSV or XLSX) from QuickBooks, Xero, FreshBooks, Wave or a spreadsheet, e.g. open_invoices.csv.

download_url.description: Temporary download link for the file, supplied by ChatGPT.

file_name.description: Original file name if known, e.g. statement.pdf.

mime_type.description: Media type if known, e.g. application/pdf.

amount.description: Invoice total, e.g. 1200 or "$1,200.00". Negative for a credit memo.

amount_paid.description: Amount already paid on this invoice, e.g. 200. Default 0.

balance.description: Open balance if known, e.g. 1000. Used instead of amount minus paid.

due_date.description: Due date, e.g. "2026-08-31". Leave out to use terms.

email.description: Customer billing email for the reminder, e.g. ap@acme.com.

invoices.description: Open invoices: an array of objects like {customer:"Acme Corp", invoice_number:"INV-1042", invoice_date:"2026-08-01", terms:"Net 30", amount:1200, amount_paid:200}, or pasted CSV/TSV text with a header row, or one line per invoice like "Acme Corp, INV-1042, 2026-08-01, Net 30, 1200, paid 200". Give this or file.

message.description: Short note printed on every statement, e.g. "Thank you for your business."

overdue_only.description: true to make statements only for customers with past-due invoices. Default false.

remit_to.description: Payment instructions printed on each statement, e.g. "ACH or check to Bright Path Design, 12 Main St".

sender_name.description: Name to sign the reminder emails with, e.g. "Dana Lee".

name: generate_customer_statements
title: Generate customer statements
